The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

• Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"at-risk\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.

• Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

• SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.

• Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

• Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.

• Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements

• Data Handling: 1–3 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.

• SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.

• Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).

• Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements

• Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.

• Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"noisy\" data, and propose actionable solutions.

• Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.

• Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

• Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.

• Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.

• Prior Forecasting experience

Advanced English

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: QA/QC Manager – Data Centers
description:
The Client


Datacenter People is working with the largest building commissioning and operational risk management providers in the world.


What the Job Involves…

  • Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its core values.
  • Performs quality inspections in accordance with program quality control documentation. Participate and guide project quality control from kick-off until hand-off.
  • Provides oversight of the implementation of the QA/QC management system at site.
  • Coordinates the quality inspections with the site sub-contractors and vendors.
  • Coordinates with the customers representative on all quality matters.
  • Provides oversight in the distribution of relevant QA/QC documentation to site subcontractors while reviewing that completed documentation is stored appropriately upon completion.
  • Verifies that the quality related site activities are in accordance with the design documents and program standards.
  • Participates in the internal and external site audits.
  • Coordinates all the quality site inspections through the Contractor QC team.
  • Ensures all quality control documentation is compiled and competed for as-built hand over through the Contractor QC team.
  • Provide review and reporting of all non-conformance reports and undertake remedial action. Monitors the implementation of the approved site QC Plan.
  • Completes and coordinates the approval of the sites QC technical submittals to the customer.
  • Coordinates with the Client and Contractor QA/QC team on all quality issues.
  • Coordinate and chair the QA/QC site weekly meetings with the Contractor QC personnel.
  • Assures all technical documents relative to site quality control are of current status.


We’re Looking for Someone Who…

  • Data center commissioning/QA experience.
  • Has a Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline preferred.
  • Has Certifications in Lean, Six Sigma, Quality Auditor, and/or Quality Engineer a plus.
  • Is experienced with ISO 9001 certification process.
  • Has a history and experience driving improved Quality at scale.
  • Is able to work seamlessly across functional and department lines.
  • Has experience with standard data center equipment to include: electrical distribution equipment from switchgear to panelboards, VFDs, low voltage power and moulded case circuit breakers, overhead IT busway, Diesel Generators, DX units, air handlers, water treatment equipment, BMS modules, and hot aisle containment accessories.
  • Is able to travel domestically and internationally as needed.


We regret that due to the high volume of applications we are unable to acknowledge each one. Please bear in mind that if you are selected for interview we will contact you within the next seven days.

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: QA/QC Manager – Data Centers
description:
The Client


Datacenter People is working with the largest building commissioning and operational risk management providers in the world.


What the Job Involves…

  • Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its core values.
  • Performs quality inspections in accordance with program quality control documentation. Participate and guide project quality control from kick-off until hand-off.
  • Provides oversight of the implementation of the QA/QC management system at site.

title: Gerente de projetos
description:
Realizar a gestão de projetos analisando o contexto da empresa e do cliente e controlando os contratos, visando a sua execução e finalização, dentro dos prazos, escopo, custos, riscos e qualidade acordados entre empresa, cliente e fornecedor.


Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimentos em GIS e na plataforma ArcGIS;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Metodologias Ágil em geral e/ou pós-graduação/MBA em Gestão de Projetos e/ou experiência comprovada em Gestão de Projetos.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Mestrado;
  • Certificações Doutorado/Pós-Doutorado;
  • Inglês Fluente/Avançado;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão em profundidade os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos e orçamentos;
  • Conceito de metodologias de Gestão de Projetos.


Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar Projetos de baixa, média e alta complexidade, com uma carteira de aproximadamente 10 projetos simultâneos, sendo responsável, de forma integrada, pela comunicação, escopo, prazo, custo, qualidade, profissionais, fornecedores, stakeholders, riscos, visando o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Responder pelo planejamento, estruturação e viabilização das condições para execução dos projetos, alinhado com os objetivos e diretrizes definidos pelo cliente e pela empresa, aplicando metodologia de gestão de projetos, ferramentas de metodologias ágeis, provendo e utilizando os processos, técnicas e artefatos (documentos) pré-definidos, buscando atender aos resultados de custo, qualidade, produtividade e margem esperados;

  • Gerenciar contratos como preposto.
  • Responder pelo planejamento, estruturação e viabilização das condições para execução dos projetos, alinhando com os objetivos e diretrizes definidos pelo cliente e pela empresa, aplicando metodologia de gestão de projetos, provendo e utilizando os processos, técnicas e artefatos (documentos) pré-definidos, buscando atender aos resultados de custo, qualidade, produtividade e margem esperados;
  • Ter visão de negócio Imagem e Cliente propondo soluções/projetos;
  • Ter habilidade na condução de reuniões e atendimento a clientes.

  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.

Experiência prática de até 3 anos com Node.js em backend.

title: Partner Success Executive - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Partner Success Executive position focuses on managing relationships with Senior Advisors - senior referral partners committed to generating leads through introductions. This role involves ensuring advisors achieve their lead goals through effective time management, process execution, and relationship building while maintaining engagement cadence, tracking performance metrics, and optimizing targeting strategies to drive high-quality introductions and conversions.


Key responsibilities


- Onboarding new Senior Advisors by establishing clear expectations around introductions, engagement cadence, and performance metrics.

- Providing ongoing support to advisors as the primary point of contact, maintaining structured 1:1 meetings to track pipeline and engagement, guiding targeting strategy and ideal prospect profiles, and monitoring performance metrics.

- Managing introductions and lead generation by qualifying prospects before engagement, connecting with introduced prospects in a timely and professional manner, managing follow-up cadence through conversion or disqualification, and handing off qualified leads to Sales Operations with proper documentation.

- Driving advisor engagement by maintaining motivation and retention, facilitating participation in advisory tasks, events, and networking initiatives, collecting structured feedback to improve program design, and ensuring positive experience and long-term program loyalty.

- Providing feedback to advisors on introduction quality and outcomes while optimizing targeting based on conversion data.

- Driving continuous improvement by proposing process enhancements where applicable.


Requirements


- Account Management Experience: 4+ years of relevant experience in Account Management or Business Development roles in similar environments.

- US Market Knowledge: 1+ year of experience working with the US market in sales, business development, or account management capacity.

- Energy and Motivation: High energy levels and self-driven motivation to achieve results.

- People Skills: Excellent interpersonal abilities and relationship-building capabilities.

- Communication Excellence: Strong selling, communication, and negotiation skills.

The Executive Headhunter position focuses on identifying, attracting, and assessing top talent for senior-level positions. This role combines executive search methodology with talent assessment expertise to place high-performing leaders who can drive organizational success and strategic growth for clients.


Key responsibilities:


- Conducting in-depth interviews and evaluations to assess candidates' qualifications, experience, cultural fit, and potential.

- Designing and executing customized search strategies to identify high-caliber talent for executive or senior-level roles.

- Facilitating the offer process, including salary negotiations and contract discussions, to ensure smooth placements.

- Proactively identifying and attracting top-tier candidates through networking, referrals, market research, and digital platforms.


Requirements:


- Experience: At least 5 years in recruitment, preferably in executive search.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Psychology, Human Resources, or related field.

- Market Knowledge: Experience recruiting for US candidates and commercial openings.

- Assessment Skills: Excellent interviewing and candidate assessment abilities.

- Industry Understanding: Knowledge of various industries and executive roles.

- Work Style: Ability to work independently and manage multiple search assignments.

- Language Skills: Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!
